youtube.title: Zoomy's Road Trip Opposites! Stop and Go (BOING!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🚗 BOING! Zoomy the car bounced over a hill and all the opposite words flew out! Can you help Zoomy find them?

Learn opposites on a road trip with Zoomy: GO and STOP, FAST and SLOW, LOUD and QUIET! Zoomy drives past the city, the farm, the pond and the ocean, and you hear the REAL sounds of the car, the bus, the horse, the duck and the rooster. Then sing Zoomy's driving song, and stay till the end, because someone is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn what opposites are
✔️ Learn 3 opposite pairs: go/stop, fast/slow, loud/quiet
✔️ Hear real vehicle and animal sounds
✔️ Sing a driving song about opposites with Zoomy!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Hello from Zoomy!
0:04 BOING! Oh no!
0:09 Let's learn opposites!
0:26 Sing along!
0:46 Who's behind the board?
0:56 What's the opposite of up?

💬 What is the opposite of up? Tell Zoomy in the comments!
